# QR Code Generator 🚀

A simple QR Code Generator built with **Python, Flask, HTML, and CSS**.

## 📌 About

This project allows users to generate QR codes from text or URLs through a simple web interface.

## 🛠️ Technologies Used

* Python
* Flask
* QRCode Python Library
* Pillow
* HTML
* CSS

## ✨ Features

* Generate QR codes from text or URLs
* Simple and user-friendly interface
* QR code generated as a PNG image
* Flask-powered web application

## 📂 Project Structure

```text
qr-code-generator/
│
├── app.py
├── qr.py
├── my-qr-code.png
├── README.md
│
└── templates/
    └── index.html
```

## ⚙️ Installation

Clone the repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Tabish07-dev/qr-code-generator.git
```

Go to the project folder:

```bash
cd qr-code-generator
```

Install the required packages:

```bash
pip install flask qrcode[pil]
```

Run the application:

```bash
python app.py
```

Open your browser and visit:

```text
http://127.0.0.1:5000
```
